name: Iwaizumi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Iwaizumi town emblem in white: a jagged crown-like device enclosing a ring flanked by two pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Iwaizumi, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 January 1966.

features.role: Iwaizumi town emblem — a jagged crown-like device enclosing a ring flanked by two pointed strokes
